sources.title: bhaskaro/ainotes-whisper-gujarati-q5_1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Whisper Gujarati (small) — GGML q5_1 A GGML conversion of vasista22/whisper-gujarati-small, quantised to q5_1 for on-device use with whisper.cpp. 190 MB. Runs faster than real time on a 2020 mid-range phone (Snapdragon 720G, 4 threads). Measured Scored on 24 FLEURS gu_inclips through whisper.cpp itself, with the same decoding settings the application uses — greedy, no_timestamps.
